map_provenance: raw static terrain-manifest geometry; Nav2 costmap inflation applied once
local_obstacles: Nav2 VoxelLayer from ground-filtered L2 point cloud
pointcloud_height_filter_reference: connected trusted ground planes from 0.5 m XY cells; unsupported cells retained as uncertain obstacles
ground_filter: near-body seed plane and bounded residual expansion; no independent platform-top fits or root-height fallback classification
observation_stop_gate: fresh distinct lidar frame, finite current pose, single supervisor and fresh structured goal heartbeat; only running motion may drive
global_live_lidar: marking and clearing both enabled; raw hit rays clear previously observed free space
local_inflation: Nav2 InflationLayer radius 0.20 m (0.15 m body radius plus 0.05 m clearance), cost scaling 0.8; local cells projected to /navigation/local_inflated_points
rgb_camera_role: RViz visualization only; not used by navigation policy
recovery: Nav2 BackUp recovery; supervisor backtracks to last safe odometry pose, then scores reachable side waypoints with Nav2 planner
control_bridge: ROS 2 commands flow to the existing Isaac Python locomotion controller
